headline: Xankəndi: foots_hill settlement with 4,400 residents and unpriced property market

summary: Xankəndi has a population of 4,400 and covers 21.8 km² with a population density of 440 per km². The area features 70 bus stops, 3 bus routes, and 4 rail stations with a transport index of 72 compared to the national median of 47. Paved roads account for 63% of known surfaces, yielding an infrastructure index of 79 versus the national median of 45. Property listings data is entirely absent, and price metrics are not available.
